name: deepdive-cpq
description: DD CPQ skills and the DD CPQ connector, in one plugin. Skills update themselves from the repo; the connector is the hosted DD CPQ MCP server.

plugins.name: dd-quoting-agent
plugins.description: For sales reps: a digital colleague that builds and changes quotes, explains prices, and runs your day, renewals and approvals in DD CPQ. It asks before every save and can undo its last change. Shortcuts: /quote, /my-day, /renewals, /approvals, /setup.

plugins.name: dd-cpq
plugins.description: Every DD CPQ skill (rule authoring, quoting, bundles, rate plans, testing, dev workflow) and the DD CPQ connector, which signs you in to Salesforce as yourself.

plugins.name: dd-cpq-readonly
plugins.description: For testers: every DD CPQ skill with the read-only DD CPQ connector. It can look up quotes, prices and rules but cannot change anything.
